text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated GPU pool 'dc-prod-1' reached 100% reserved capacity and autoscale failed to add nodes. Queue growth detected. Incident ID: INC-20250324-09. Paging maya (oncall).

maya (oncall): saw the alert, pulling up dashboards now. queue length trending up?

ops-bot: metric snapshot: pool_util=1.00, queued_requests=247, avg_wait_ms=1830, failed_scale_attempts=3, scale_error='insufficient_quota'

maya (oncall): @sam can you confirm whether cloud quota limits are the cause or if the autoscaler crashed?

sam (runtime): looking at cluster logs. Autoscaler attempted 3 launches at 09:12, 09:14, 09:16 UTC and got 403 from provider: "QuotaExceeded: GPU quota exceeded". Also seeing intermittent grpc timeouts to the scale controller.

maya (oncall): ok mark root cause as quota exhaustion until proven otherwise. Immediate mitigation: 1) throttle non-reserved tenants 2) move critical reserved enterprise tenants to fallback pools 3) notify CS + Sales. I'll start the throttling runbook.

maya (oncall): /runbook throttle-dedicated-pool --pool dc-prod-1 --priority low_non_reserved

ops-bot: executed: throttle policy updated. Non-reserved routes now limit to 20rps per-tenant.

sam (runtime): I'm opening emergency scale request with cloud support to increase GPU quota. Ticket: CSP-84721 opened at 09:22 UTC. ETA unknown.

eileen (sre): I'm going to identify noisy neighbors. Running query against runtime logs to find top GPU consumers in last 30m.

sam (runtime): result preview: tenant: acct-enterprise-9 uses 38% of active GPUs with 6 long-running sessions; acct-startup-21 spiked with a big batch job, 22% usage.

maya (oncall): lia (customer-success) please start customer callbacks for the top affected reserved tenants and tell them we're mitigating. janet (sales) loop in for the enterprise contract owners.

lia (customer-success): calling acct-enterprise-9 now. FYI they reported errors around 09:10 UTC. They see "capacity exhausted" errors in their app. I'll update as I talk to them.

janet (sales): thanks lia. I'll prepare a short exec note template for enterprise owners.

maya (oncall): e: can we evict or pause batch jobs from non-critical tenants? Prefer graceful preempt rather than killing.

eileen (sre): yes. identified PIDs and request IDs for startup-21 batch. Suggest throttle + preempt for jobs older than 5m with low priority tag. Command: ```python
# preempt heuristic
for job in jobs:
  if job.priority == 'low' and job.runtime > 300:
    mark_for_preempt(job)
```

sam (runtime): applied preempt label to 4 batch jobs from acct-startup-21. Estimated freed GPUs: 3. Queue length decreased to 198. avg_wait_ms -> 1460ms.

maya (oncall): good. still not enough. Can we failover some reserved tenants to 'dc-prod-2' pool (cross-region)? That requires approval due to data residency but customers on this call are ok if temporary. lia: do we have permission?

lia (customer-success): acct-enterprise-9 authorizes temporary failover to dc-prod-2 for 2 nodes. I'll document consent in the ticket.

sam (runtime): starting cross-pool migration for acct-enterprise-9 sessions (2 nodes). Command: ```sh
redwood migrate-session --from-pool dc-prod-1 --to-pool dc-prod-2 --tenant acct-enterprise-9 --nodes 2
```

ops-bot: migration started, tracking task TASK-9923.

maya (oncall): update: after throttle + preempt + migration of 2 nodes, pool_util=0.94, queued_requests=120, avg_wait_ms=900. Still above SLO for some tenants.

eileen (sre): I've correlated noisy patterns: acct-enterprise-12 had a runaway inference loop from a misbehaving client causing high KV-cache churn. We should engage their engineering contact and suggest model variant with lower memory.

lia (customer-success): contacting acct-enterprise-12. They're acknowledging and will patch.

sam (runtime): cloud support responded: they can raise GPU quota but will take ~2 hours for allocation. In parallel we can attach burst capacity (spot) but it's not allowed for some enterprise reserved workloads.

maya (oncall): plan for next 2 hours: 1) keep throttle in place for non-reserved 2) continue migration of consenting reserved tenants to dc-prod-2 3) evict/preempt batch jobs 4) CS to maintain customer comms 5) Engage legal if any data residency concerns for cross-pool moves.

janet (sales): noted. I'll stand by for any contract escalations.

ops-bot: checkpoint saved to incident record INC-20250324-09 at 09:48 UTC.

maya (oncall): handing off to sam (runtime) for the steady-state and cloud quota follow-up. I'll remain available for escalation. On-call handover: maya -> sam.

sam (runtime): taking over. Current metrics: pool_util=0.92, queued_requests=96, avg_wait_ms=720. tracking CSP-84721 and TASK-9923. Next update in 30m or on any customer impact change.

ops-bot: reminder: please run post-mortem template when incident resolves: /postmortem create --incident INC-20250324-09 --owner sam

lia (customer-success): acct-enterprise-9 confirms reduced errors after migration. They're asking for root cause summary and ETA for full restore. I'll coordinate update for 10:30 UTC.

sam (runtime): noted. beginning regular checks and log collection. logs attached to TASK-9923.```
